item.title: Movie Theater Chains Unite To Call Out Netflix and They're Demanding Answers
item.description: A major Hollywood shake-up is looming, and the people who run movie theaters aren’t thrilled with how little clarity they’re getting. item.description: When The Acolyte hit Disney+ in 2024, it instantly became one of the most talked about Star Wars projects in years. Some fans loved how far it pushed the mythology. Others pushed back hard.
